Fascias, Soffits and Dry Verge in Stafford and Staffordshire

We fit fascia boards, soffit boards and dry verge across Stafford, Lichfield, Tamworth, Cannock and Stoke-on-Trent. The photo on this page shows new white soffit boards under the eaves on one of our jobs.

Call 07478 904491 WhatsApp Us

New Soffits Under the Eaves

Soffit boards close off the underside of the eaves, and the fascia board along the front edge is what the gutter is fixed to. The job in our photo has new white soffits running the length of the eaves, fitted from the scaffold.

Dry Verge on the Gable Ends

Dry verge is a fixed capping along the gable edge of a roof, used in place of the old mortar bedding under the end tiles. It's one of the services we offer.

Easiest While the Scaffold Is Up

Fascias and soffits sit right at the eaves, so they're easiest to replace when there's scaffold along the house for other roof work, as there was for the soffits in our photo. If you're having a new roof or the gutters done, ask us to look at the boards at the same time.

Signs It Needs Looking At

These are general signs, not a diagnosis. If you spot one, call or send us a photo and we'll tell you what we think.

  • Fascia boards that are rotten, split or flaking
  • Soffits sagging, or gaps where birds get in
  • Mortar dropping out along the gable edge of the roof
  • Gutters pulling away because the board behind them has gone

Useful to Tell Us

  • Whether it is the fascias, the soffits, the gable verge or all three
  • Roughly how long the run is
  • Whether the gutters need doing at the same time
